name: spAriaUtil
title: spAriaUtil - Client
summary: The spAriaUtil API provides methods to show messages on a screen reader.
overview: This API is an angular service that you can use in Service Portal widget client scripts.

members.name: sendLiveMessage
members.summary: Announce a message to a screen reader.
members.html:
The sendLiveMessage() method injects text into an aria-live region on the page. The default setting for an aria-live region is assertive, which means that messages are announced immediately. This can annoy and confuse users if used too frequently.

Parameters
Name Type Description
message String The message to be shown.
Returns
Type Description
void 
function(spAriaUtil) {
  /* widget controller */

  spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage('Hello world!');
}
